mechanism: Chlorthalidone can cause hypokalemia and hyponatremia which may potentiate gabapentin's CNS effects and increase risk of adverse neurological events; gabapentin is renally cleared and thiazide diuretics may impair renal function.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (particularly potassium and sodium), and CNS side effects; adjust gabapentin dose if renal function declines; consider alternative antihypertensive if significant electrolyte disturbances develop.
